payload.statement: The failure reproduced in 5/5 valid control trials on razorpay-vulnerable. It was not observed in 20 valid trials on razorpay-fixed under the same DNA conditions. If razorpay-fixed still failed independently with per-trial probability 0.9900, the chance of seeing no failures in 20 valid trials would be (1-0.9900)^20 = 1.00e-40 <= 1%. Under the same independence assumption, about 0.150 is an approximate 95% upper bound on razorpay-fixed's per-trial failure probability for this reproducer. This does not establish correctness for other schedules, loads or environments.
